eps.o: Tony promises his friends a park day, but Ultron steals the toys.
Amadeus upgrades a truck, but accidentally turns it into a giant chicken!
The Iron Friends must save the pier—then stop Ultron from turning Stark Expo into Ultron Expo!
Absorbing Man steals the power of bouncy boots.
Ultron crashes beach day to build his HQ, and the Iron Friends must stop him.
the Iron Friends race to save Granny Williams' peach pies from Swarm's stink bugs.
Ultron takes over the airwaves, and the Iron Friends must stop him.
A visit from T'Challa turns tense when a device threatens his suit and the IQ.
Ultron steals Cap’s power-pack and goes turbo.
Riri's playground plans are bugged by Swarm's power-draining robo-mosquitoes.
Tony tries to move a boulder blocking the trail.
Riri wants to play paper boats, but Swarm has drained the creek to ruin the park.
In Wakanda, Ultron steals Black Panther's tech and must be stopped.
At Doggy Adoption Day, Swarm uses collars to cause chaos with the pups.
The Iron Friends must stop Absorbing Man, who steals a pitching machine to wreak havoc.
Amadeus plans a bioluminescent wave party, but Swarm shows up to cause trouble at the IQ.
Amadeus uses a robot costume for Halloween, but it goes on a candy rampage.
Swarm steals all the pumpkins, and the team must get them back.

eps.t: Special Delivery for the Iron Friends
eps.o: The Iron Friends must stop delivery bots that have gone rogue.
Tony, Riri, and Amadeus try to fix Howard Stark’s failed invention, but it causes chaos at Stark Expo.
When Ultron turns Vision into a baby, the Iron Friends must retrieve the device to fix him.
The Iron Friends team up to stop Swarm and her Slime Bugs from ruining a car show.
Amadeus shows off his high-tech bee hive, but when Swarm attacks, the Iron Friends must save the day and the bees.
The Iron Friends stop Ultron from making everyone float away.
While camping, the Iron Friends track down missing snacks.

eps.t: Swarm and Bugs Go to a Concert
eps.o: The Iron Friends must stop Swarm's Robo-Crickets from ruining Howard's concert and wreaking havoc at Stark Expo.
Cap and Iron Man struggle to work as a team when Ultron hits the mall.
Absorbing Man steals a gem that deflects the Iron Friends' beams, forcing them to find a new way to stop him.
When Ultron steals all the presents, the Iron Friends must save Christmas.
Ana and Tony head to the Winter Festival, but Absorbing Man freezes the whole event.
The Iron Friends head to Beachside Mall, where Hawkeye reveals Absorbing Man is behind the thefts.
The Iron Friends' sleepover is interrupted by Ultron, who steals the Arc Reactor.
The Iron Friends stop Ultron's teddy bears from ruining Valentine's Day.

eps.t: The Iron Friends and the Trouble at the Tar Pits
eps.o: The trio must save the mammoth exhibit when Swarm and Absorbing Man cause chaos at the tar pit museum.
Absorbing Man gains magnetism and threatens Stark Expo.

eps.t: The Iron Friends and the Baby Birds
eps.o: The Iron Friends protect a bird's nest from Swarm's "Paint Bugs" attack.

eps.t: The Iron Friends vs. the Iron Fiends
eps.o: When Iron Friend imposters cause chaos, the team must clear their names.
Vision's art tour turns dangerous as Ultron threatens to make the museum vanish.
The Iron Friends use giant-sized armour to battle Ultron in his Ultimo Suit.

eps.t: The Mighty Thor and Mischievous Loki
eps.o: When Thor visits, Loki causes trouble, and the kids armor up to stop him and save the city.
Ultron steals Vibranium to power his Robotic Racer.
Swarm ruins the hover scooter launch at Stark Expo, and the team must stop her Lightning Bugs from glitching their suits.
The Iron Friends plan Gamma's birthday, but Ultron ruins it by showing up in a giant unicorn piñata.
Iron Man and Ironheart must retrieve a stolen arc reactor and save the day.

eps.t: Hawkeye and the Super Smelly Stink Arrows
eps.o: Hawkeye and Iron Man must stop Ultron from using stink arrows to take over the pier.
Loki brings Riri's favorite sci-fi film to life.
Loki brings Riri's favorite game to life, and she must defeat the villain to win.

eps.t: Let's Go Fly an Iron Kite
eps.o: Swarm's Robotic Bot-terflies threaten a perfect day for flying kites at the beach.
Tony and Scott help T'Challa set up a Vibranium exhibit at Stark Expo, but Ultron steals it.

eps.t: Thor and Loki Hit the Road
eps.o: The Iron Friends and Thor race to retrieve stolen RC racers from Loki.
Swarm and her Robo-Moths steal a lighthouse beacon.
When Loki enchants a water park mascot, Iron Man and Thor must stop it.
Absorbing Man uses sticky honey to steal everything at the Farmer's Market.

eps.t: Swarm's Baseball Swing and a Mess
eps.o: Riri, Tony, and Amadeus help build a baseball field, but Swarm's Pop Flies threaten it.

eps.t: Thor and the Legends of Asgard
eps.o: The Iron Friends visit Thor in Asgard, only for Ultron to try ruling the realm.

eps.t: The Iron Friends and the Hot Air Balloons
eps.o: Swarm crashes a hot air balloon festival with her Robotic Needlenose Bugs.
Gamma and a squirrel grow giant after being hit with Pym Particles.
The team chases Loki to stop the enchanted monorail.
Aña joins Tony, Riri, and Scott at the pier, but Swarm's robo-crabs cause a shellfish mess.
The Iron Friends armor up to stop Ultron's "Ultron Says" ray from controlling the city.
